warrior.name: Bash Echo
warrior.text: Shield Bash hits one more enemy behind the first.

warrior.name: Hold the Gate
warrior.text: While enemies are taunted by Challenge, you can't be knocked back.

warrior.name: Bloodied Banner
warrior.text: Kills give allies within 8 blocks 5% attack damage for 6 s.

archer.name: Running Shot
archer.text: Firing a bow while sprinting no longer slows you.

archer.name: Quick Draw
archer.text: A bow kill makes your next draw 50% faster.

rogue.name: Ambusher
rogue.text: Your first hit after leaving Vanish deals 30% more.

rogue.name: Choking Smoke
rogue.text: Enemies inside your Smoke Bomb are slowed.

rogue.name: Pickpocket
rogue.text: Sneaking up to a villager and using it gives one random trade item, once a day per villager.

beastmaster.name: Shared Meal
beastmaster.text: Eating food also heals your pets within 10 blocks for half as much.

beastmaster.name: Rolling Herd
beastmaster.text: Stampede knocks enemies back further and slows them.

beastmaster.name: Whisperer
beastmaster.text: Animals tame on the first try.

cavalry.name: Fighting Retreat
cavalry.text: Being knocked off your mount gives you Speed II for 3 s.

cavalry.name: Whistle
cavalry.text: Sneak and use a lead to call your last horse to you from up to 64 blocks away.

duelist.name: Honour Duel
duelist.text: Against an enemy with no other enemy within 8 blocks, you take 10% less damage.

duelist.name: Perfect Riposte
duelist.text: Riposte Stance counters also stagger the attacker.

guardian.name: Iron Will
guardian.text: Taunting Shout also gives you Resistance I for 4 s.

guardian.name: Counterweight
guardian.text: Blocking a melee hit knocks the attacker back.

guardian.name: Second Guard
guardian.text: After your shield is disabled, it recovers twice as fast.

skirmisher.name: Kite
skirmisher.text: Your speed boost on hit also makes your next dodge free.

skirmisher.name: Light Feet
skirmisher.text: You take no fall damage from falls of up to 6 blocks.

crossbowman.name: Heavy Bolts
crossbowman.text: Crossbow bolts knock the target back.

crossbowman.name: Saturation
crossbowman.text: Volley Fire fires one more bolt.

crossbowman.name: Practised Hands
crossbowman.text: A kill instantly reloads your crossbow.

spearman.name: Long Haft
spearman.text: Your spear reach bonus rises from 0.5 to 1 block.

spearman.name: Return to Hand
spearman.text: Thrown spears come back to you.

monster_hunter.name: Long-Lasting Oil
monster_hunter.text: Silver Oil lasts twice as long.

monster_hunter.name: Giant Slayer
monster_hunter.text: You deal 10% more damage to bosses.

monster_hunter.name: Skinning Knife
monster_hunter.text: Monsters you kill have a 10% chance to drop a second set of loot.

bounty_hunter.name: Weighted Bola
bounty_hunter.text: Bola also pulls the target 2 blocks toward you.

bounty_hunter.name: Better Pay
bounty_hunter.text: Your hired muscle has 30% more health.

bounty_hunter.name: Bring Them In Alive
bounty_hunter.text: Enemies below 20% health that you hit are slowed for 2 s.

battle_mage.name: Controlled Channel
battle_mage.text: Overchannel's extra mana cost drops from 30% to 10%.

battle_mage.name: Mana Shockwave
battle_mage.text: Mana Burst knocks enemies 6 blocks back instead of 4, and slows them.

battle_mage.name: Mana Ward
battle_mage.text: When you are hit, 10% of the damage is taken from your mana instead.

sentinel.name: Rooted
sentinel.text: Your standing-still Resistance also gives knockback immunity.

sentinel.name: High Post
sentinel.text: While on Watchtower, your ranged attacks deal 15% more.

sentinel.name: Night Watch
sentinel.text: You see enemies within 12 blocks through walls at night.

paladin.name: Chain of Light
paladin.text: Holy Smite jumps to one more undead within 6 blocks.

paladin.name: Holy Ground
paladin.text: Allies standing on Consecrate get Regeneration I.

paladin.name: Shared Shield
paladin.text: Divine Shield also shields the nearest ally for half as much.

corsair.name: Grapple
corsair.text: Boarding Hook can pull you to blocks as well as boats.

corsair.name: Rousing Shanty
corsair.text: Sea Shanty's attack speed boost rises from 20% to 30%.

corsair.name: Sea Legs
corsair.text: In water your attacks are 20% faster.

blacksmith.name: Field Repairs
blacksmith.text: Repairing gear at an anvil or in a crafting grid restores 25% more durability.

blacksmith.name: Ringing Blow
blacksmith.text: Hammer Strike also stuns for 0.5 s.

blacksmith.name: Well Made
blacksmith.text: Gear you craft loses durability 15% slower.

cleric.name: Rebuke
cleric.text: Turn Undead also sets them alight.

cleric.name: Blessed Brew
cleric.text: Healing potions you drink heal 25% more.

farmer.name: Rich Soil
farmer.text: Compost also makes crops near it grow 20% faster for 5 minutes.

farmer.name: Scythe Swing
farmer.text: Hoes hit every enemy in front of you.

farmer.name: Farmhand
farmer.text: Breeding animals gives one more experience orb.

merchant.name: Haggler
merchant.text: Villager trades cost one emerald less, never below one.

merchant.name: Hired Swords
merchant.text: Caravan Guard calls one more guard.

merchant.name: Regular Customer
merchant.text: Wandering traders find you twice as often.

rancher.name: Long Call
rancher.text: Herd Call reaches twice as far.

rancher.name: Quick Breeding
rancher.text: Animals you breed can breed again 50% sooner.

miner.name: Bright Lamp
miner.text: Miner's Lamp lights twice as far.

miner.name: Cave Dweller
miner.text: Below sea level you mine 10% faster.

miner.name: Gem Cutter
miner.text: Diamond and emerald ore has a 10% chance to drop one more.

explorer.name: Climber
explorer.text: You climb ladders and vines 50% faster.

alchemist.name: Double Batch
alchemist.text: Brewing has a 15% chance to make one more potion.

alchemist.name: Strong Arm
alchemist.text: Splash and lingering potions are thrown 50% further.

alchemist.name: Tolerance
alchemist.text: Harmful potion effects on you last 25% shorter.

sailor.name: Pearl Diver
sailor.text: Deep Breath also gives Night Vision underwater.

sailor.name: Sea Bounty
sailor.text: Fishing from a boat catches treasure more often.

fisher.name: Barbed Hook
fisher.text: Hook and Reel makes the target bleed for 1 damage a second for 3 s.

fisher.name: Feeding Frenzy
fisher.text: Chum the Water also draws in fish twice as fast for 30 s.

bard.name: Deep Sleep
bard.text: Enemies put to sleep by Lullaby take 20% more damage from the first hit that wakes them.

bard.name: Inspiring Tale
bard.text: Good Company's bonus rises from 10% to 15%.

herbalist.name: Forager's Eye
herbalist.text: Herbs and flowers within 8 blocks sparkle when you sneak.

herbalist.name: Antidote
herbalist.text: You are immune to Poison I.

herbalist.name: Master Stew
herbalist.text: Suspicious stew you make lasts twice as long.

beekeeper.name: Angry Swarm
beekeeper.text: Swarm's bees poison what they sting.

beekeeper.name: Royal Jelly
beekeeper.text: Eating honey also gives Regeneration I for 5 s.

beekeeper.name: Pollinator
beekeeper.text: Crops and flowers near you grow 15% faster.

gravedigger.name: Grave Robber
gravedigger.text: Graves and tombs you dig up have one more item.

gravedigger.name: Soul Lantern
gravedigger.text: Your lantern makes undead within 8 blocks glow.

zealot.name: Penance
zealot.text: Damage you deal to yourself with skills is returned to the nearest enemy within 6 blocks.

zealot.name: Shared Suffering
zealot.text: During Martyrdom, 15% of the damage you take is also dealt to your attacker.

zealot.name: Pyre of Faith
zealot.text: Enemies killed while burning from Burning Faith explode in holy fire for 4 damage within 3 blocks.

cook.name: Spice Rack
cook.text: Food you cook gives 10% more saturation.

cook.name: Hearty Meal
cook.text: Food effects from meals (Nourishment, Comfort) last 25% longer.

cook.name: Kitchen Knife
cook.text: Knives and cleavers deal 15% more damage.

lumberjack.name: Orchard Keeper
lumberjack.text: Leaves you break drop apples twice as often.

lumberjack.name: Sawmill
lumberjack.text: Logs give one more plank when crafted.
